title: Asymmetric constitutive representation decomposition
question: Can the compact 178-point adaptive representation recover the preregistered Richards bottom-flux fidelity when retention is kept exact while capacity and conductivity remain lookup-based?
primary_observable: absolute bottom-flux delta versus fully analytical provider
interpretation_rule: If exact theta alone collapses the response error while exact C or exact K does not, prefer a split representation over globally tightening the joint lookup.
